instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-full shot from a low angle in an indoor judo dojo with a yellow mat. The young woman in the blue judo gi (R1) is on all fours on the mat, facing left with her head down. Leaning over her from behind, the young man in the white judo gi (R2) grips her waist and belt, preparing a grappling move. The scene is illuminated by soft, even indoor lighting with a natural color palette.
